ui.eyebrow: 100% Local · Zero Uploads · Free & Open Source
ui.dropTitle: Drop an image or PDF here
ui.dropSub: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, GIF, or PDF (single & multi-page). Processed completely inside your browser.

trust.title: Nothing Leaves Your Device
trust.body: Your files are processed in the browser and never uploaded. No cookies. Check the DevTools Network tab yourself.

trust.title: Vector PDF Preservation
trust.body: PDF inputs stay sharp vectors via single-XObject PDF clipping instead of blurry raster screenshots.

trust.title: Exact Seam Alignment
trust.body: Includes glue overlap tabs, corner (+) crosshairs, an assembly map, and a 50 mm / 2 in scale check.

guide.svg1Aria: Diagram 1: Trim top and left margins only
guide.svg2Aria: Diagram 2: Glue tab and crosshair alignment
guide.cap1: 1. Cut along the TOP and LEFT crop lines on overlapping sheets so the clean edge sits smoothly over the previous sheet's glue tab.
guide.cap2: 2. Run glue stick along A1's dashed right overlap strip, then align A2's trimmed left edge directly onto the (+) crosshairs.
guide.cap3: 3. Before cutting a large pattern or poster, measure the Page 1 calibration ruler to confirm your printer did not shrink pages.

footer.aboutText: A single-purpose, open-source web utility for printing large posters, blueprints, maps, and sewing patterns on a regular home printer.
